"Constructive criticism is more than ok. It's how we get better things. If people didn't care and give such criticism then we'd see no improvement in the things we love."

"It's important to remember the majority of people who are fans of certain IPs who are critical do not want the projects to be bad and fail. A lot of their criticism comes out of love and the wanting for projects to be written better."

"The majority of fans who've been lifelong fans of an IP just want great storytelling and further fleshing out of the characters they've loved forever and new ones who have great purpose and substance. To act as if a small portion of fans are the majority is not healthy."

"They want sacrifices, cornerstone characters, and the overall history to be respected/have meaning. There will (sadly) always be some fans who are just assholes and trolls. However, they do not make up the majority of fanbases. We must stop acting like they are."

"In the end, all fans of anything want are stories that respect the lore and the history that allowed the newest project to exist. Doing so allows for clearer, more connected storytelling that will be cherished. They want those projects to have characters with depth and substance."
"It is ok to criticize a character and how they're written. It is ok to criticize the writing of a project. It is not ok to be an ass toward the actor who plays the character."
